minutes.headline: Sewer Commission approved Il Forno's outdoor-building use change, pending the plumbing inspector's sign-off on grease traps.
minutes.summary: The commission heard the owner of Il Forno's describe a new building replacing a tent and discussed grease trap capacity and seating. It voted to approve the use change contingent on the plumbing inspector's approval. It then began reviewing a combined pump station and generator RFP, leaning toward one contract at the supervisor's preference and a capped remote-response charge; the review was unfinished.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to approve a use change at Il Forno's on Electric Ave, pending the plumbing inspector's approval.
The owner described a new building replacing a tent; the commission discussed grease trap capacity and seating before voting.
The commission began reviewing a combined pump station and generator RFP and did not finish; it deferred to the supervisor's preference for one contract.
The RFP timeline was set with proposals due May 31 and an award June 13, ahead of the contract expiring June 30.
The commission agreed to cap billable remote alarm response outside business hours at a monthly number of hours, with no charge during business hours.

why_it_matters: The grease trap condition and the RFP both bear on how sewer system costs and service are managed, which are paid for through sewer rates and fees.
The pump station and generator maintenance contract expires June 30, so the terms set in this RFP, including the after-hours charge cap, will govern what the sewer system pays for upkeep.
watch_next: April 26: Paula consults Town Counsel on charging an expansion fee when bedrooms are added, before any commission vote.
